"This is a celebrated Vachana composed in Kannada by Basavanna, the founder of the Virashaiva movement in 12th-century Karnataka: 'The rich will make temples for Shiva. What shall I, a poor man, do? My legs are pillars, the body the shrine, the head a cupola of gold. Listen, O Lord of the meeting rivers (Kudalasangamadeva), things standing shall fall, but the moving ever shall stay.'
